title: LS-docs: CLAUDE.md, resume and orchestrate skills describe compact-in-place and a current-state plan.md
spec:
Docs only; match the terse style of each file. Lands after LS1 (T-1592), whose hook prints the plan.md '## Now' section after compaction.

1. CLAUDE.md step 9 (line 22) becomes: at [planner].handover_context_tokens, run `uv run orchestrator handover --reason context --session-id <id>` and keep working; the session compacts in place (launcher --autocompact, or /compact from the terminal or Remote Control) and the SessionStart compact hook re-injects the plan.md '## Now' brief; restart with `f orch` only if compaction fails. Drop the '150k context tokens (or after 150 turns)' wording.
2. CLAUDE.md step 5 (line 18): after 'overwrite plan.md' add that plan.md is current state only: '## Now' first (goal, next step, open human decisions), under 10k chars, the auto-handover section last; status lines are appended to .orchestrator/plan-log.md, which resumes do not read.
3. .claude/skills/resume/SKILL.md Procedure: read plan.md '## Now' and the goal sections, not .orchestrator/plan-log.md (only when a needed fact is missing, and then grep it).
4. .claude/skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md Procedure: when overwriting plan.md keep '## Now' current; append status lines to .orchestrator/plan-log.md.
Do not edit any other file.
acceptance: grep -c 'compacts in place' CLAUDE.md returns at least 1 and grep -c 'or after 150 turns' CLAUDE.md returns 0
grep -l 'plan-log.md' CLAUDE.md .claude/skills/resume/SKILL.md .claude/skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md lists all three files
